Assuming you meant **"What is the tallest mountain in the world above sea level?"**:

The tallest mountain in the world above sea level is **Mount Everest**, located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas on the border between Nepal and Tibet. 

Its official elevation is **8,848.86 meters (29,031.7 feet)** above sea level.
